title: Identifying and Mitigating API Misuse in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2503.22821v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: API misuse in code generated by large language models (LLMs) presents a serious and growing challenge in software development, as although LLMs demonstrate impressive code generation capabilities, their interactions with complex library APIs are often error-prone and can lead to software failures and vulnerabilities. In this paper, we conduct a large-scale study of API misuse patterns in LLM-generated code by analyzing both method selection and parameter usage across Python and Java, using three representative LLMs: StarCoder-7B, Qwen2.5-Coder-7B, and GitHub Copilot. Based on extensive manual annotation of 3,209 method-level and 3,492 parameter-level misuses, we identify and categorize four recurring misuse types by building on and refining prior API misuse taxonomies. translated_title: 识别与缓解大型语言模型中的API误用
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）生成代码中的API误用正成为软件开发中一个严重且日益加剧的挑战——尽管LLM展现出令人印象深刻的代码生成能力，但其与复杂库API的交互往往容易出错，可能导致软件故障和安全漏洞。在本文中，我们针对LLM生成代码中的API误用模式开展了一项大规模研究，通过分析Python和Java两种语言中的方法选择和参数使用情况，使用了三个具有代表性的LLM：StarCoder-7B、Qwen2.5-Coder-7B和GitHub Copilot。基于对3,209个方法级误用和3,492个参数级误用的大量人工标注，我们在已有API误用分类法的基础上进行扩展和细化，识别并归纳出四种反复出现的误用类型。对这三个LLM的评估揭示了API使用中持续存在的挑战，尤其是幻觉和意图错位问题。为解决这些问题，我们提出了Dr…（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文对三种主流大语言模型生成代码中的API误用模式进行了大规模研究，通过人工标注识别出四类常见误用类型，并针对幻觉和意图错位等问题提出了缓解方案。
en_tdlr: This paper conducts a large-scale study of API misuse patterns in code generated by three representative LLMs, identifies four recurring misuse types through extensive manual annotation, and proposes mitigation strategies addressing persistent issues such as hallucination and intent misalignment.
